name: WF-161 Portfolio Performance → Underwriting Calibration & Dynamic Strategy Feedback

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const deals=Array.isArray(input.closed_deals)?input.closed_deals:(Array.isArray(input.performance_records)?input.performance_records:[]); const sample=deals.length; const profits=deals.map(d=>Number(d.realized_net_profit??d.realized_profit??d.net_profit??0)).filter(Number.isFinite); const costs=deals.map(d=>Number(d.total_costs??0)).filter(Number.isFinite); const days=deals.map(d=>Number(d.days_to_close??0)).filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v)&&v>0); const positive=profits.filter(v=>v>0).length; const losses=profits.filter(v=>v<0).length; const avg=a=>a.length?a.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0)/a.length:0; const avgProfit=avg(profits); const avgCost=avg(costs); const avgDays=avg(days); const profitabilityRate=sample?positive/sample:0; const lossRate=sample?losses/sample:0; const variance=profits.length?avg(profits.map(p=>(p-avgProfit)**2)):0; let status='calibration_insufficient',route='WF-140 CRM closeout → portfolio performance & deal intelligence'; let recommendation={}; if(sample>=10){const profitBuffer=variance>0?Math.min(0.1,Math.sqrt(variance)/Math.max(Math.abs(avgProfit),1)*0.1):0; const speedFactor=avgDays>120?0.05:avgDays>90?0.03:avgDays<30? -0.02:0; const lossAdjustment=lossRate>0.2?-0.05:lossRate<0.05?0.02:0; const boundedAdjustment=Math.max(-0.1,Math.min(0.03,lossAdjustment-speedFactor-profitBuffer)); status='calibration_ready'; route='WF-142 dynamic MAO → property-level offer strategy'; recommendation={sample_size:sample,average_realized_profit:avgProfit,average_total_cost:avgCost,average_days_to_close:avgDays,profitability_rate:profitabilityRate,loss_rate:lossRate,profit_variance:variance,dynamic_mao_adjustment:boundedAdjustment,adjustment_cap:{downside:-0.1,upside:0.03},rationale:'Bounded calibration from realized profitability, loss rate, closing speed, and profit variance.'};} return [{json:{workflow_id:'WF-161',workflow_name:'Portfolio Performance → Underwriting Calibration & Dynamic Strategy Feedback',status,sample_size:sample,calibration:recommendation,routing:{next_route:route,next_workflow:route.startsWith('WF-142')?'WF-142':null},guardrails:{minimum_sample_size:10,downside_adjustment_cap:0.1,upside_adjustment_cap:0.03,no_unbounded_mao_changes:true,realized_performance_only:true,human_review_for_exceptions:true},crm_activity:{event_type:'underwriting_calibration_feedback',outcome:status},idempotency_key:'wf-161:calibration:'+(input.batch_id??input.event_id??'portfolio')}}}];
